dialog.llm.intro: The prompt is on your clipboard (click Copy to copy it again). Paste it into your LLM, then copy its reply and click Paste.
dialog.llm.terminal_help:
Copy the text above into your LLM, then paste its response below.
Press Enter on an empty line when done (or leave empty to cancel):
dialog.review.hint: Tick the cards you want to remove. Making a choice locks that group (🔒); click a lock to lock or unlock a group yourself. Auto-select fills in every group that isn't locked (Undo takes it back). Keys: A/D or ←/→ change page, W/S or ↑/↓ scroll (not while the search box has focus; press Enter there to leave it).
dialog.review.search_placeholder: Search filename, folder or character name
dialog.review.status_kept: {count} kept (you've made choices in them since)
dialog.review.confirm_all_body:
In {count} group(s) every card is ticked, so no copy of that character would be left.

Trash them anyway?
dialog.review.confirm_close_body: {count} card(s) are ticked. Close without trashing anything?
dialog.review.title: Review similar characters
dialog.review.desc_cover: The cover images look alike. Different characters in the same pose can match too — check before removing.
dialog.review.desc_name: Same first and last name. Outfits, overlays or edits may differ.
dialog.review.desc_filename: Same file name apart from the trailing number, in {folder}
